sources.chronology: One season-forward OOF fold per target season; schedule metadata reads identity/time/type columns only.
Each row's latest history date is strictly earlier than the target; physical historical publication times remain uncertified.

Development-fixed calibrator assessed on reused 2023-24 Validation; non-null feature source dates are earlier than kickoff. Null marks no prior eligible game in either team state and is governed by season-opener/prior defaults.

systematicModelError.qualification: Slate means localize common-direction model error; correlations are descriptive and not causal weather/source attribution.

unsupported: MLB: no admitted chronological whole-game Development forecast ledger; Final OOT and sealed data were not opened.
Totals joint calibration: retained point expectations are not line-event probabilities.
NBA start-window analysis: Development ledger records dates but not exact tip times.
Shared weather/geography: no common governed pregame environmental fields across ledgers.
Standings/tournament incentive causality: identifiers are insufficient to prove absence of changing later-game incentives.
Prospective certification: all admitted ledgers are reconstructed chronological evidence without physical per-game publication clocks.
